{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the number of unique patient_ids
num_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Verify that there are no missing or invalid patient IDs
assert df['patient_id'].isnull().sum() == 0, "There are missing patient IDs"

# Check the range of patient IDs to ensure they are consistent
patient_ids = df['patient_id'].unique()
assert all(id_.startswith('P') and id_[1:].isdigit() for id_ in patient_ids), "Patient IDs are not in expected format"

# Confirm the total number of rows and unique patients
num_rows = len(df)

num_patients, num_rows"}
